page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.6xlarge is a high-capacity storage and memory-optimized server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Powered by a 3.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8559C processor, this instance provides 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs using the x86_64 instruction set. It includes 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, supported by 320 MB of L3 cache. Local storage is directly bundled with a 15,000 GB NVMe SSD array, while network capacity provides a 25 Gbps baseline connection.

Benchmark evaluations highlight exceptional single-threaded compute and fast memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier Geekbench single-core ratings alongside high single-threaded Gzip compression and Bzip3 decompression rates. Large-block memory write speeds score in the strong percentile, supporting static web serving rates up to 45.64 GB/sec. Multi-core operations across stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and Redis SET workloads remain solidly within middle-tier expectations, while text generation for small LLM models exhibits top-tier speeds.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, bundling 15 TB of high-speed local NVMe storage with 192 GB of high-frequency RAM provides significant hardware density. This reduces reliance on network-attached block volumes for I/O-intensive services. The system is best fitted for high-throughput relational and NoSQL databases, search indexing, real-time log analytics, content serving, and cached data processing pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services i7ie.6xlarge is a Nitro-powered storage and memory-optimized server equipped with a 12-core, 24-vCPU Intel Xeon 8559C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 192.0 GB of 6 GHz DDR5 memory, a 320 MB L3 cache, 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and a bundled 15,000 GB local NVMe SSD. Benchmark results showcase top-tier single-core CPU speeds and small-model LLM generation performance, accompanied by strong memory write bandwidth, decompression throughput, and static web serving capacity. Multi-core compute and database operations perform solidly within average parameters. The high resource density of local storage paired with large memory capacity delivers efficient operating economics for disk-heavy and memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The i7ie.6xlarge is suited for transactional databases, search engines, real-time analytics, static content delivery, and cached data processing.
